review.notes: Full review of the folder at the head. Gate FAIL, reproduced (blob=7, sorry-data=5, imports=1, mathlib-subimports=1; outside-folder hits are the PR's own folders). Depcheck: 239 roadmaps, 2424 edges, 0 problems; it exempts main-to-main edges, and R01 records the ReductiveGroups <-> ReductiveGroupsPartII cycle (README 692/716/839/1077 vs Part II 341/5214/1442). Seeded sample: 'Supplier:' (RG2.3.7 resolved on main; Milne Prop 27.54 p.487 and Cor 27.55 p.488 checked at milne-iag lines 20248-20268) and 'Cross-cutting prerequisite: sheaves and descent' (no owner, no locator; owners at the pins named in R05). Also checked: dudas-michel Prop 8.7/8.9, Thm 9.6, Thm 10.1; conrad-feng Prop 12.3.1; milne-iag Prop 1.14, Summary 1.17, Prop 5.48. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry warnings only; #check of all 15 declarations shows no lost binders; one-tactic probes close specGroupObject and finrank_indFromProjectedLevi. Four companion files elaborate; SignedADE, FoldingADE and CoverLift were not elaborated. Adversarial table: 30 rows. Main blocking issues: 45 sorry'd data declarations; a large block of targets already proved in pinned Tau Ceti (anti-equivalence, GL_n embedding, closed-orbit lemma, char-0 reductive = linearly reductive, Borel conjugacy, signed ADE shell Lie algebra and folding, F4/G2 special isogenies); no headline theorem in Suggested.lean.
